title: STELLAR Alpha 0.4 — We found an old ship, lost signals, and room for a crew. Come aboard. Web BROWSER friendly /  COOP NEEDED ! And LOVE ALSO ^^
author: Own_Difference577
selftext:
**Hi Reddit! 👋**  
I'm Johan, a solo designer / developer from Belgium, and I've been building a strange little sci-fi universe called **STELLAR** for about a year.

It started as a personal experiment: one HTML file, one old spaceship, and a lot of ideas that probably should have been separated months ago. 😅

I'm now releasing **STELLAR Alpha 0.4** and, more importantly, I'm curious to see whether this little universe could grow beyond my own desk.

I'm not looking for a huge team or trying to launch the next MMO.  
**I'm looking for a few curious people who like sci-fi, exploration, game systems, music, storytelling — or simply like taking weird prototypes apart to see what makes them tick.**

Especially if the idea of helping shape the **BOOMER**, its crew, its future encounters and eventually its cooperative side sounds fun.

**If that sounds like your kind of thing, come say hi.**  
You can try the Alpha  soon here and contact me through the project page:

👉 [**https://t3wm.com/stellar-demo/stellar.html**](https://t3wm.com/stellar-demo/stellar.html)

**Come aboard. 🚀**  
  
**STELLAR is an atmospheric sci-fi exploration game built around one strange old ship:**   
**the BOOMER.**

Its is an old vessel. Not the fastest. Not the newest.  
But it has one useful trick:

**"it can slip under some radar systems and pick up signals other ships miss."**

That means there are places worth going simply because **the BOOMER can hear things others can't.**

You can fly it alone.  
**You can walk around inside it.**  
Move between stations, look around, and interact with parts of the ship.

The idea is that the ship itself can become part of the gameplay :

Navigation.  
Coordinates.  
Energy management.  
Radar and communications.  
Weapons and ship systems.  


\-You can explore.  
\-You can dock at stations.  
\- Leave the ship.  
Follow strange signals.  
Encounter Aliens maybe , drones , mines fields, abandoned places, other ships… and things that probably shouldn't be there.

But the BOOMER was also built with **multicrew in mind**.There is room for more than one person aboard.

Pilot.  
Copilot.  
Systems.  
Radar.  
Weapons.  
EVA / exploration.

The idea isn't to build a giant MMO.

**Just a few people, one ship, and somewhere to go : IMAGINE :** 

Maybe you fly while a friend watches the radar.  
**Or listens to the music we just found.**

Someone picks up a signal while covering you with the side Gatling.  
Another takes the belly turret.

Someone launches the drone and leaves the ship to investigate.

And suddenly, the little trip you planned  
**turns into an adventure.**

**And this is only the BOOMER.**

Later, I'd love to add other ships —  
different layouts, different roles, different ways to explore the same universe.

**Not every ship should work the same way.**

**STELLAR is still Alpha 0.4.**

It's rough.  
Some things break.  
Some controls are still prototypes.  
Some worlds are more “promise” than finished destination.

But the universe is already there. And the BOOMER is waiting.

**Come aboard.**

**Maybe we'll find out where it goes.**

**THE CODE IS THE KEY.**  
**BUT YOU ARE THE PATH.**   
  
SEE YOU OUT THERE.

(x) SHill  

u/stellargame
